title: 问路
target: asking where a place is; 对面 and 旁边
curriculumStatus: Beginner prototype; HSK level mapping and native-speaker review pending

nodes.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Yǒu shénme shì ma?
nodes.speaker: student
nodes.hint: Ask where the bookstore is: 请问，一号书店在哪儿？

nodes.zh: 一号书店啊？就在光明电影院对面，星光百货旁边。
nodes.pinyin: Yī hào shūdiàn a? Jiù zài Guāngmíng diànyǐngyuàn duìmiàn, Xīngguāng bǎihuò pángbiān.
nodes.en: No. 1 Bookstore? It's right opposite the Guangming Cinema, next to Starlight department store.
nodes.note: 对面 (duìmiàn) is opposite or across from; 旁边 (pángbiān) is next to.
nodes.speaker: student

nodes.zh: 不客气！走过去两三分钟就到了。
nodes.pinyin: Bú kèqi! Zǒu guòqu liǎng sān fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
nodes.en: You're welcome! It's a two- or three-minute walk.
nodes.speaker: student

found.zh: 找到了！这就是一号书店。
found.pinyin: Zhǎo dào le! Zhè jiù shì Yī hào shūdiàn.
found.en: Found it! This is No. 1 Bookstore.
found.speaker: narrator
